daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but electric today. There's something about the cosmos pushing you to level up without losing that cozy Taurus essence. Trust the slow burn—magic's happening beneath the surface.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your quiet confidence, and honestly? That's the real move. Whether you're coupled or solo, lean into authenticity over performance. Your energy speaks louder than words ever could right now.
daily.career: The universe is rewarding your consistency today. You don't need to force anything—just show up as yourself and let your work do the talking. Small wins are building toward something bigger than you realize.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding practices today. Whether it's a walk, stretching, or just being present with what you're eating, listen to that instinct. You're naturally resilient; honor that by staying connected to yourself.

weekly.overview: This week invites you to lean into your sensual side, Taurus. The cosmic energy supports meaningful conversations and creative breakthroughs. Trust your gut when something feels off—your intuition is sharper than usual right now.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, vulnerability is your superpower this week. Someone's noticing the real you beneath the surface. Don't dim your light to seem more available. Authenticity hits different when you're being unapologetically yourself.
weekly.career: Your persistence is about to pay dividends. You might feel like progress is slow, but the groundwork you've laid is solid. A collaboration or partnership idea gaining traction could shift your professional trajectory. Stay grounded in your vision.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for slowness this week. Prioritize rest over productivity. Nourishing rituals—whether that's cooking, long showers, or stretching—will restore your energy. Listen when you need to pause. Your wellness depends on honoring those signals.
